messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for AI without making unsupported claims?

已查到可引用的部分資料：

### Short answer
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for AI without unsupported claims, you need formal R&S product/configuration evidence, formal competitor evidence, and AI-specific test evidence that ties both sides to the same AI use case, KPIs, setup, options, software versions, and test conditions; current battle cards and PR-level AI claims are not enough by themselves.[15][17][24][41][43]
### Evidence required
| Evidence needed | Why it is required | Current passage support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| Formal R&S specifications and features for the Signaling Tester side, especially CMX500 hardware, supported RATs, signaling/application features, RF conditions, options, and limits. | CMX500’s formal evidence says it is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD, while the CMX500 page distinguishes binding specifications from non-binding feature data.[52][69] | Use CMX500 Specifications Version 11.00 and CMX500 Features and Functions Version 32 / CSW 9.20.0 and higher, not sales battle cards, as the formal R&S basis.[69] |
| Formal R&S option/order-code evidence for the signaling functions being claimed. | CMX500 signaling options are explicitly listed for WLAN, LTE, NR, RedCap, eRedCap and NTN with codes and order numbers, so any signaling comparison should cite the actual relevant options instead of general claims.[70][71] | Supported examples include R&S CMX-KS600B/M/X for NR signaling Rel. 15, R&S CMX-KS617B/M/X for NR Rel. 17 RedCap, and R&S CMX-KS627B/M/X for NR Rel. 17 NTN.[70][71] |
| Formal or validated evidence for the Non-signaling Tester side, including exact product line, configuration, options, and production or manufacturing scope. | Manufacturing / production testing is separately described with goals such as high yield, shortest test time, RF transceiver characterization, debug and trace, and the listed tools include CMP180, CMP200, CMW100, CMX500/CMW500 for signaling, and CMQ.[36] | Battle-card claims that CMP180, CMP200 and CMW100 K06 form a production / ATE / non-signaling path need the relevant product specifications or product pages if used in customer-facing comparison.[21] |
| Formal evidence for any CMX500 non-signaling claim if CMX500 itself is part of the non-signaling story. | The CMX500 GPRF Generator is described as a CMX500 non-signaling use case for generating ARB, CW, dual tone or replay `.wv` waveform, but its source is a presentation, not a formal feature list or specifications.[46][47] | The GPRF Generator source also has license ambiguity, because “No License required” is only a slide claim and technology-specific ARB replay / WinIQSim2 waveforms require KWxxx licenses.[47] |
| AI-specific R&S evidence defining the AI test use case and KPIs. | The China Mobile Research Institute demo ties CMX500 to generative AI application user-experience testing under diverse network conditions, with CMX500 configuring network parameters, fading, latency, jitter and RF impairments, and the KPIs include Time to First Token and Tokens Per Second.[43][45] | This supports an AI application UX test story for CMX500, but it is a PR/demo-level solution description rather than a competitor comparison or binding configuration.[43][45] |
| AI scripting / automation evidence, if the comparison is about AI-assisted tester operation rather than AI-application testing. | The CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant is described as an AI-powered tool for the CMX500 5G one-box signaling tester that uses generative AI and natural language processing to generate, extend and explain XLAPI scripts.[40][97] | The same source does not provide formal model/version/license/order number, deployment details, supported LLM model, security controls, update mechanism, script accuracy, validation workflow, or GA availability.[41] |
| Official competitor specifications, product brochures, configuration guides, option codes, software versions and test conditions for every competitor claim. | For Anritsu, the knowledge base says R&S battle-card claims must be checked against Anritsu official data and third-party evidence before customer use.[15] | The Anritsu MX844030PC brochure can describe MX844030PC, MD8190A and the Virtual Signalling Tester, but it cannot validate R&S advantages over CMX500.[15][76] |
| Official competitor evidence for Keysight if Keysight is the competitor. | The Keysight comparison page says the current Keysight claims come only from an R&S internal battle card and that customer documents should use Keysight official material and third-party evidence.[24] | The Keysight battle card lacks official Keysight document numbers, versions, order numbers or dates for the UXM models, and RFU18 / FR3 / AI Script Assistant boundaries still need sources.[25] |
| Official competitor evidence for Amarisoft if Amarisoft is the competitor. | The Amarisoft comparison page says the claims currently come only from an R&S internal battle card and that customer documents should use Amarisoft official data and third-party evidence.[17] | The Amarisoft battle card lacks formal evidence for employee range consistency, support footprint, up to 1000 UEs, NTN/RedCap capabilities, PTCRB/GCF alignment, Samsung validation, and production path details.[81] |
| Validation or conformance reports where the comparison claims validated testing, operator acceptance, PTCRB/GCF alignment, or conformance leadership. | Amarisoft battle-card claims around PTCRB/GCF aligned tests, operator acceptance and validated NTN lack test package option codes, accreditation documents, Samsung validation reports and test case lists.[79][81] | Keysight battle-card NTN claims also lack validation reports, PTCRB RFT 555 version and test case lists.[87] |
| Comparable test setup evidence for throughput, latency, TTFT, TPS, fading, RF impairment, bandwidth, FR2/FR3, WLAN, NTN, RedCap or production test time claims. | CMX500 formal specifications state product data applies only under defined conditions such as warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval and internal automatic adjustments, and the document separates binding specifications from typical or non-binding data.[52][69] | Battle-card bandwidth, data-rate, RFU18 and TCO claims lack test conditions, option codes, versions, setup details or calculation bases.[24][25][94] |
| Third-party or customer-neutral evidence for “better,” “only,” “first,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” “industry-leading,” or similar advantage claims. | The Anritsu, Amarisoft and Keysight comparison pages all state that these are sales-positioning sources rather than binding specifications, and the pages warn that “only,” “industry-leading,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” and similar phrases should not be treated as verified technical specifications.[13][15][16][17][22][24] | TCO claims specifically need price, license count, calibration cost assumptions, trade-in terms or a calculation basis, which the Anritsu battle card does not provide.[94] |
| A direct AI-to-competitor comparison source, or parallel official evidence showing both our solution and the competitor tested the same AI workload under the same conditions. | The R&S-China Mobile source supports a CMX500-based generative AI UX testbed and its TTFT/TPS KPIs, but the competitor comparison pages are sales battle cards and do not provide an AI-specific measured comparison against the same setup.[43][13][16][22] | Without same-scenario competitor evidence, the knowledge base supports describing our AI test method and separately describing competitor product facts, but not claiming superiority for AI.[43][15][17][24] |
### Bottom line
Current evidence supports saying that CMX500 has formal signaling, RF and application-test documentation, and that R&S has PR/demo evidence for CMX500-based generative AI user-experience testing with TTFT and TPS KPIs.[52][68][43][45]  
Current evidence does not support a customer-facing AI superiority comparison against Anritsu, Keysight or Amarisoft unless official competitor documents, third-party evidence, and same-scenario AI test results are added.[15][17][24]

Virtual Signalling Tester › 來源定義
[[mx844030pc-j1200]] 將 [[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 描述為 software protocol simulator / Virtual Signalling Test Solution，透過虛擬化 protocol stack，在 PC 上重現多個 protocol layers：

- [[RRC-NAS]]
- [[PDCP]]
- [[RLC]]
- [[MAC]]

來源主張它可不使用一般硬體測試儀而在 PC 上快速建立 protocol test environment；但 RF-IF configuration 仍使用 [[Anritsu MD8190A]] Universal RF Unit 與 [[MX819020A]] RF Platform。

Virtual Signalling Tester › 與 Virtual tester 的區分
[[Virtual tester]] 在 [[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 中是 R&S AI Workplace questionnaire 的 agentic workflow concept，跨 implementation、test、debug、validation。

[[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 則是 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 中 Anritsu NR / RedCap protocol simulation and test product / solution 語彙。兩者名稱相近，但目前沒有來源支持它們是同一產品、同一架構或同一市場分類。

Virtual Signalling Tester
[[Virtual Signalling Tester]] 是 [[mx844030pc-j1200]] 中 Anritsu 對 virtualized protocol stack test solution 的產品 / 解決方案語彙，核心是用 PC-based software protocol simulator 建立 NR / RedCap protocol test environment。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500 vs Anritsu
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Anritsu]] 的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 calibrated [[FR2]] / [[mmWave]] testing？
2. 是否需要 global support、multi-year warranty 或 calibration services？
3. 是否需要 [[Operator Acceptance]]、[[Conformance Testing]] 或 pre-conformance？
4. 是否需要 validated / [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] aligned test cases，而不只是 functional simulation？

CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100 › 重點摘要
- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD 與 TDD device testing。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 配置包含 OBT lite、OBT、OBT plus、OBT FR1 specialist、OBT FR2 specialist，主要差異在 [[R&S CMX-B200A]] accelerator unit、[[R&S CMX-B500A]] IF unit、[[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF unit 的數量。
- [[NR FR1]] 與 [[LTE]] 測試使用 integrated RF units；[[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF unit 的 frequency range 為 **400 MHz to 8000 MHz**。
- [[NR FR2]] 測試可搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] remote radio head；remote radio head 在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。
- 適用的 radiated chamber test environments 包含 [[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 vector signal analysis 與 ARB generator，可做 FR2 transmitters / receivers RF parametric testing；5G NR receiver tests 可在 3GPP fading propagation conditions 下使用 internal baseband fading emulation。
- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘，符合指定 environmental conditions，遵守 recommended calibration interval，且已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

| AI-specific R&S evidence defining the AI test use case and KPIs. | The China Mobile Research Institute demo ties CMX500 to generative AI application user-experience testing under diverse network conditions, with CMX500 configuring network parameters, fading, latency, jitter and RF impairments, and the KPIs include Time to First Token and Tokens Per Second.[43][45] | This supports an AI application UX test story for CMX500, but it is a PR/demo-level solution description rather than a competitor comparison or binding configuration.[43][45] |
| AI scripting / automation evidence, if the comparison is about AI-assisted tester operation rather than AI-application testing. | The CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant is described as an AI-powered tool for the CMX500 5G one-box signaling tester that uses generative AI and natural language processing to generate, extend and explain XLAPI scripts.[40][97] | The same source does not provide formal model/version/license/order number, deployment details, supported LLM model, security controls, update mechanism, script accuracy, validation workflow, or GA availability.[41] |
| Official competitor specifications, product brochures, configuration guides, option codes, software versions and test conditions for every competitor claim. | For Anritsu, the knowledge base says R&S battle-card claims must be checked against Anritsu official data and third-party evidence before customer use.[15] | The Anritsu MX844030PC brochure can describe MX844030PC, MD8190A and the Virtual Signalling Tester, but it cannot validate R&S advantages over CMX500.[15][76] |
| Official competitor evidence for Keysight if Keysight is the competitor. | The Keysight comparison page says the current Keysight claims come only from an R&S internal battle card and that customer documents should use Keysight official material and third-party evidence.[24] | The Keysight battle card lacks official Keysight document numbers, versions, order numbers or dates for the UXM models, and RFU18 / FR3 / AI Script Assistant boundaries still need sources.[25] |
| Official competitor evidence for Amarisoft if Amarisoft is the competitor. | The Amarisoft comparison page says the claims currently come only from an R&S internal battle card and that customer documents should use Amarisoft official data and third-party evidence.[17] | The Amarisoft battle card lacks formal evidence for employee range consistency, support footprint, up to 1000 UEs, NTN/RedCap capabilities, PTCRB/GCF alignment, Samsung validation, and production path details.[81] |

| Comparable test setup evidence for throughput, latency, TTFT, TPS, fading, RF impairment, bandwidth, FR2/FR3, WLAN, NTN, RedCap or production test time claims. | CMX500 formal specifications state product data applies only under defined conditions such as warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval and internal automatic adjustments, and the document separates binding specifications from typical or non-binding data.[52][69] | Battle-card bandwidth, data-rate, RFU18 and TCO claims lack test conditions, option codes, versions, setup details or calculation bases.[24][25][94] |
| Third-party or customer-neutral evidence for “better,” “only,” “first,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” “industry-leading,” or similar advantage claims. | The Anritsu, Amarisoft and Keysight comparison pages all state that these are sales-positioning sources rather than binding specifications, and the pages warn that “only,” “industry-leading,” “lower TCO,” “fewer boxes,” and similar phrases should not be treated as verified technical specifications.[13][15][16][17][22][24] | TCO claims specifically need price, license count, calibration cost assumptions, trade-in terms or a calculation basis, which the Anritsu battle card does not provide.[94] |

### Bottom line
Current evidence supports saying that CMX500 has formal signaling, RF and application-test documentation, and that R&S has PR/demo evidence for CMX500-based generative AI user-experience testing with TTFT and TPS KPIs.[52][68][43][45]  
Current evidence does not support a customer-facing AI superiority comparison against Anritsu, Keysight or Amarisoft unless official competitor documents, third-party evidence, and same-scenario AI test results are added.[15][17][24]
